$comment: NOT a golden manifest. Each entry records how WRONG our ACTIVITY-engine SVG emission is today against the jar oracle under DeterministicMeasurer, measured by tests/oracle/svg-conformance/activity.diff-baseline.ratchet.test.ts over the committed corpus at test-results/dot-cache/activity/<slug>/{in.puml,in.svg} (D4/D1 -- no SVG is copied here). Rendered WITH the vendored-stdlib include store (tests/helpers/fixture-include-store.ts), the same seam every svg-conformance surface uses. Population: 373 committed activity fixtures (scripts/oracle-corpus.ts:58 idiom, plugin.type === 'activity', D3), of which 23 have a golden that is the jar's OWN graphical error page (PSystemError.java:148-155 / ReportLog.java:103-108) and record status:"jar-error" with NO weightedScore -- the jar failing is no evidence about us (D12). 90 have our OWN parser refusing the source (renderFixtureActivity throws) and record status:"error" with a reason, never a number (D8); 8 of those 90 overlap the 23 jar-error fixtures and are recorded as "jar-error" (D12: a fixture in BOTH exclusion sets records jar-error, since the jar's failure makes our own outcome unevidential either way). That leaves 268 status:"baseline" entries with a numeric weightedScore -- NOTE: the original T2 task spec and decisions.md D12's own arithmetic (373 - 23 - 90 + 8) both state this figure as 283; the literal arithmetic of that formula is 268, and 268 is what direct measurement over the committed corpus produces (23 jar-error, 82 error-only, 8 overlap, 268 baseline; 23+82+268=373). Flagged for review, not silently corrected: see T2's report. THE GATED QUANTITY IS weightedScore, NOT diffCount (D2, plans/sequence-root-chrome/decisions.md D5): compareNodes short-circuits on node-type, tag and child-count mismatch, charging exactly 1 for each however large the skipped subtree, so diffCount is NOT monotone in wrongness. weightedScore charges each short-circuit an upper bound on what descending could have cost, so it IS monotone in alignment and is what this ratchet gates. diffCount is kept as an INFORMATIONAL field only. A RISEN diffCount beside a FALLEN weightedScore after T5's chrome fix is the EXPECTED artefact of that weighting, not a failure -- see the $comment on this field in the sequence sibling for the full mechanism. Current state (T2, pre-chrome): 238 of the 268 baseline fixtures sit at exactly diffCount=12, all sharing the identical 12-path diff set (root chrome attributes plus svg/defs[1][childCount] and svg/g[1][childCount] -- the same family D6 targets for the chrome fix); this floor is NOT uniform across all 268 as an earlier draft of this task assumed -- 30 fixtures sit elsewhere (diffCount 10, 11, 29, 34, 35, 40, 46, 55, 58, 63, 64, 72, 73, 74). weightedScore over the 268 ranges min 166 (kodiji-34-mofe202) to max 3076, median 541. Do not hand-edit weightedScore or diffCount to make the suite pass: re-run the measurement and change weightedScore, diffCount, measuredAt and measuredAgainstCommit together.
